label.description: Accessible site label used for navigation text and logo alternative text.
label.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  label: Example Site
```

- Without a logo, this text is shown in the navigation.

- With a logo, this text becomes the image alternative text.

- When omitted, Norna uses the homepage title.

[Navigation identity reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/sitewide-content.md#navigation-identity)

logo.description: Optional display settings for a convention-based navigation logo.

height.description: Displayed logo height. Width follows the intrinsic aspect ratio.

logo.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  label: Example Site
  logo:
    height: 2rem
```

`logo` optionally overrides the displayed height of the logo file that Norna discovers automatically. It does not enable or select the file.

[Navigation logo filenames and placement](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/public-files.md#navigation-logo)

navigation.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  label: Example Site
```

`navigation` defines the identity shared by the homepage and every route. Routes cannot replace it.

[Navigation identity reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/sitewide-content.md#navigation-identity)

id.description: Stable banner identifier used for dismissal state.

oneOf.title: Warning
oneOf.description: Present the banner as an important warning notice.

visible.description: Optional date window for the banner.

from.description: First date on which the content is visible.

until.description: First date on which the content is no longer visible.

banners.markdownDescription:
```yaml
banners:
  - id: project-status
    tone: warning
    title: Experimental code
    text: Not for production use.
```

Adds dismissible notices above page content. List order controls their presentation order; each `id` must be unique.

[Banner reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/sitewide-content.md#banners)

copyrightMessage.description: Copyright or ownership text shown in the site footer.

enabled.description: Show generated build information in the footer.

text.description: Label shown before the generated build timestamp.

locale.description: Intl locale such as en-GB or sv-SE.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone such as Europe/Stockholm.

dateStyle.description: Intl dateStyle for the build timestamp.

oneOf.title: Short
oneOf.description: Use a compact localized date or time representation.

oneOf.title: Medium
oneOf.description: Use a moderately detailed localized representation.

oneOf.title: Full
oneOf.description: Use the most detailed localized representation.

timeStyle.description: Intl timeStyle for the build timestamp.

oneOf.title: Short
oneOf.description: Use a compact localized date or time representation.

oneOf.title: Medium
oneOf.description: Use a moderately detailed localized representation.

oneOf.title: Full

dateTimeFormat.description: Formatting used for the generated build timestamp.

footer.markdownDescription:
```yaml
footer:
  copyrightMessage: Copyright Example Owner.
```

Adds shared footer content. Generated build information is optional.

[Footer reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/sitewide-content.md#footer)
